description: Get 2-3 recommended bullion product TYPES for a goal (hedge, stacking, gift, collecting, IRA) with the reasoning for each, plus the cheapest live verified offers for those types fitted to a budget. Use this for beginner / first-time-buyer / what-should-I-buy questions even when no budget or goal is stated — budgetUsd is optional and a $1,000 default budget applies (the result labels it budgetDefaulted), and goal is optional with a 'stacking' default for general-purpose buying (the result labels it goalDefaulted).

budgetUsd.description: Budget in USD (optional; default $1,000 when omitted, labeled budgetDefaulted in the result).

goal.description: Buying goal (optional; default 'stacking' when omitted, labeled goalDefaulted in the result).

sellHorizon.description: When the buyer might sell: 'soon', 'years', or 'long_term' (default 'years').

name: what_should_i_buy
title: What Should I Buy
